notable_absence.finding: The page names 18 distinct statistics charts on the Search page alone (Search Query Latency, Search Docs, Search Disk Size, Search Disk Files, Search Memory Segments, Search Disk Segments, Search Mutations Remaining, Search Partitions, Search Partitions Expected, Search Records to Persist, Search Index Rate, Search Result Rate, Search Compaction Rate, Search Query Rate, Search Query Error Rate, Search Slow Queries, Search Query Timeout Rate, Term Searchers Start Rate), each with its own one-line definition, plus a 19th (Search Mutations Remaining) on the Dashboard page. These were deliberately NOT each minted as a separate concept - that would be 18-19 near-identical, low-reuse-potential metric-name concepts for one page - but the names and definitions are real, quotable content a future round or a coordinator may want; recorded here in full so nothing is silently dropped. Example verbatim definitions: 'Search Slow Queries: The number of queries that run slowly (Greater than 5 seconds to run) per second.' and 'Search Query Timeout Rate: The number of queries that timeout per second.'
